title: The Danish jazz club head and a contract to Denmark
summary: After the New York festival and a Staten Island Ferry concert, the scruffy visitor turns out to head Danish jazz clubs and mails him a contract.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: And, I don't suppose you could have a better job in the whole world than that; that's the epitome. You know, there it is. So, this strange guy--- I had played the New York Festival that year and I played on the Staten Island Ferry and I had an excellent band - you know - just marvelous and this guy heard us -- this funny little man from Denmark and when he said to me - oh, Wild Bill, I actually came to hear you play all the way from Denmark; how would you like to come to Denmark? And, I've heard all of these stories before and I took one look at this guy and I thought - my God, I wonder if he is telling me the truth; I said, I'd love to come.
Kind of a scruffy looking character---

Yeah -- but it was something you wouldn't expect to be the head of all the jazz clubs in Denmark and works for the Government. Anyway, it was only a few days later, here comes a contract in the mail; he had gone home and mailed me a contract. And, that's how I got started in the European thing.
Now you, at that point, this is about, you figure - 1973---
